summary: Click a 3D object to select it, with events as the selection changes.
overview: Raycasts on click and fires OnSelected and OnDeselected as the selection changes — the RTS "click a unit" behaviour. Distinct from the UI drag tools, which go through UGUI's EventSystem rather than real scene colliders.
useCases: Selecting units or buildings in a strategy game.
Click-to-inspect in a 3D scene or product viewer.
Picking a target for an ability.

params.tuning: Keep it narrow. With everything selectable, clicking the ground deselects by selecting the ground.
Falls back to Camera.main, which is fine until the scene has more than one camera.

gotchas.title: It does not know about UI
gotchas.body: A click on a UI panel over the scene still raycasts through to whatever is behind it. Gate it on EventSystem.current.IsPointerOverGameObject when you have full-screen UI.

gotchas.title: It needs colliders
gotchas.body: A renderer alone is not hittable. Objects without a collider can never be selected.
